mentions.name: Kvile
mentions.description: A lightweight desktop HTTP client built with Rust and Tauri, featuring native .http file support (JetBrains/VS Code/Kulala compatible), a Monaco editor, JavaScript pre/post scripts, and SQLite-backed history. Starts in under a second, is MIT licensed, and has no cloud — requests stay on the user's machine.
mentions.source_excerpt: Kvile ( https://kvile.app ) — A lightweight desktop HTTP client built with Rust + Tauri. Native .http file support (JetBrains/VS Code/Kulala compatible), Monaco editor, JS pre/post scripts, SQLite-backed history. Sub-second startup. MIT licensed, no cloud, your requests stay on your machine. Think Postman without the bloat and login walls.
